remaining_gaps: Tool gap: no dossier record can express the Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1946 sec. 4 abolition of the Social Security Board as a statutory end. The TERM records joined from the plan quote other provisions (Employees' Compensation Commission; grant-in-aid coordination) and carry actor EO:8399 and mechanism own_terms_condition, which would mislabel the end.

Effective date of Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1946 rests on the Statutes at Large marginal note 'Effective July 16, 1946' only; the Reorganization Act of 1945 (59 Stat. 613) effective-date rule, and any wording on references to or orders concerning abolished agencies, is not held.

Unresolved whether both permissions lost their object when the Board was abolished (1946) or were carried to the Federal Security Administrator; a carry-over would end no later than the abolition of the Federal Security Agency (Reorganization Plan No. 1 of 1953, not held), not at EO 11408.

ACT record for EO 11408 against EO 8399 not located (dossier missing: target provision not located: EO:11408). EO 11408 sec. 2 names EO 8399 and is at most an upper bound, effective on signing 1968-04-25.

Tool gap: the Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1970 sec. 6(a)(1) abolition cannot be expressed as a statutory end; the dossier's TERM records for the plan carry actor EO:11293 and mechanism own_terms_condition, and the sec. 6 span omits the Federal Water Quality Administration and any date.

Unresolved whether the Interior Commissioner office was abolished with the Federal Water Quality Administration (1970-12-02) or its Level V placement carried to the EPA Water Quality Office until EO 11604 (1971-07-02). The plan abolishes the Administration 'exclusive of any functions' and transfers functions and personnel but does not mention the Commissioner's office; EO 11587's retitling of item (8) suggests carry-over but is the President's later drafting, not the plan.

EO 11604 (deletion of item (8), 1971-07-02) is not in the dossier: it names no EO number, so no ACT or ACTOR_TEXT record exists. An ACT override record for EO 11604 against EO 11293 (text held at jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11604.txt) would be needed for any end at 1971-07-02.

Effective date of Reorganization Plan No. 3 of 1970 (December 2, 1970) rests on the Statutes at Large marginal note only; 5 U.S.C. 906(a) / sec. 7 computation needs congressional session days, not held.

HUD organization record not held: when the Urban Transportation Administration was established in HUD, and whether it and its Director post continued after Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1968 took effect (June 30, 1968, marginal note) or ended earlier than the EO 11634 deletion of item (8) (1971-12-06).

Reorganization Plan No. 2 of 1968 transfers functions to the Department of Transportation and creates a DOT Administrator; it does not abolish the HUD Urban Transportation Administration or its Director post, so it decides neither a first end nor a carry-over.

Dossier clause inventory has 24 draft clauses from neighbouring Civil Service Commission regulations; only item (9) is EO 11299's operative clause. A corrected inventory (inventory_source_id ORIGINAL:EO:11299, chars 925-1023) would be needed before any submission.
